# pvecli sdn

Manage SDN (zones, vnets, subnets).

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`list`](list.md) | List vnets with their zone and their status on every node. |
| [`zones`](zones.md) | List SDN zones and where they are actually deployed. |
| [`info`](info.md) | Detail a vnet: definition, subnets and the guests attached to it. |
| [`health`](health.md) | Report unapplied changes and vnets missing on some nodes. |
| [`zone`](zone.md) | Manage SDN zones. |
| [`vnet`](vnet.md) | Manage SDN vnets. |
| [`subnet`](subnet.md) | Manage SDN subnets. |
| [`apply`](apply.md) | Apply the pending SDN configuration on every node of the cluster. |
| [`discard`](discard.md) | Drop every pending SDN change, back to the applied configuration. |
| [`unlock`](unlock.md) | Release a stale global SDN lock left by another session. |
